newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Jubail refinery shut down for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Jubail refinery shut down for maintenance.

text.p: The 305,000 barrels per day (bpd) Jubail oil refinery in Saudi Arabia was completely shut down on Saturday for scheduled maintenance work, an industry source said on Sunday.
Units at the Gulf plant began to be gradually closed down last week to allow work that would focus on changing Jubail's catalyst and to improve its hydrocracker, the source said.
The whole plant will be brought back to full operational rates at the end of November.
Utility units at Jubail will be brought back on stream in the coming days, the source said.
